noun_definition: web refers to the user interface environment where tasks are reported and interacted with, specifically in the context of displaying cursor behavior on completed task details.
Cursor refers to the visual indicator that shows whether an element is interactive or not, which in this Issue is incorrectly displayed as disabled when hovering over completed task details.
completed task detail refers to the information displayed for a task that has been marked as completed, which should not indicate a disabled cursor when hovered over.
